shifts.summary: The paper was overall judged moderate, with candidates reporting good attempts between 65 and 82. Reasoning was mostly easy but some found it moderate to difficult, and attempts ranged 17–24. Quantitative aptitude was widely seen as difficult, with time pressure limiting attempts to about 15–20. English was consistently described as easy, focusing on synonym‑antonym and passage items.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Reasoning was described as easy and doable within 10‑11 minutes by some candidates, while others found it moderate to difficult and lengthy.

sections.name: General Awareness

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Math section had long questions, time pressure of 15 min, candidates could attempt about 15‑16 questions, with many reporting difficulty.

intro: The SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam was conducted on 23 October 2026 across three shifts. Shifts 1 and 2 have been reported as overall moderate, with unofficial candidate‑reported good‑attempt ranges of 65‑82 and 65‑77 respectively. Reasoning was generally perceived as easy, while Quantitative Aptitude was viewed as difficult with time pressure limiting attempts. English was largely described as easy. SSC normalises scores across shifts, and the figures presented are unofficial.

faqs.q: What was the overall difficulty level of the SSC CGL Tier 1 exam on 23 October 2026?
faqs.a: Both reported shifts (1 and 2) for the 23 October 2026 exam were described as moderate overall by the majority of candidate feedback.

faqs.q: How did candidates describe the Reasoning section in the SSC CGL Tier 1 exam on 23 October 2026?
faqs.a: Reasoning was mostly reported as easy, though some candidates found certain items moderate to difficult, resulting in attempt counts typically between 17 and 24.

faqs.q: What unofficial range of good attempts was reported for the Quantitative Aptitude section on 23 October 2026?
faqs.a: Candidates for the 23 October 2026 exam indicated that good attempts in Quantitative Aptitude fell roughly between 15 and 20, reflecting the difficulty and time pressure of the section.
